create_multihost_dataloader: create a MultiHostDataLoadIterator that shards data across JAX devices from a tf.data.Dataset or Iterable dataloader
run_get_next_batch_sharded: run get_next_batch_sharded to split host-loaded data batches equally over all JAX devices with retry logic
build_global_shape_and_sharding: build global array shape and NamedSharding from local batch shape and a JAX global Mesh
form_global_array: form a JAX Array from a local numpy array by splitting across devices and placing on local JAX devices
reset_multihost_iterator: reset a MultiHostDataLoadIterator to restart iterating over the underlying dataloader with sharded device placement
